findings.title: pip-audit [tool.pip-audit] ignore-vuln block is inert; CLI ignores it, releases may block on accepted vulns (merges DEP-02)
findings.evidence: uv run pip-audit returns exit 1 reporting py 1.11.0 PYSEC-2022-42969 despite [tool.pip-audit] ignore-vuln (pyproject.toml:99-109); only --ignore-vuln flag works (exit 0, 1 ignored). security-analysis.yml:40-42 comment claims the block is honored.
findings.recommendation: Pass --ignore-vuln flags explicitly in the CI invocation or confirm the org python-ci.yml does, and correct the misleading comment.

findings.title: SLSA provenance never auto-fires; triggers on a non-existent Semantic Release workflow
findings.evidence: slsa-provenance.yml:12-15 workflow_run on workflows: ['Semantic Release'] which no workflow declares; release.yml:30 sets semantic-release: false. Provenance only via manual dispatch.
findings.recommendation: Point workflow_run at the actual release workflow name or trigger on release: published like release-sign.yml.

findings.title: development.md states 80% coverage and basedpyright standard; actual is 65 and strict; CHANGELOG claims a fix not in HEAD
findings.evidence: development.md:56 says 80% and :69 'standard' mode; pyproject.toml:115 fail_under=65 and :84 typeCheckingMode strict; CHANGELOG.md:67-69 claims both lines were already corrected.
findings.recommendation: Set development.md to 65% and strict; drop unenforced 90% rows; investigate why the CHANGELOG-claimed fix is absent from HEAD.

findings.title: Python 3.11 EOL 2026-10-31 (~5 months); floor, pin, ruff, basedpyright, CI all target 3.11
findings.evidence: Python 3.11 final security release 2026-10-31. .python-version=3.11; requires-python >=3.11,<4; ruff target-version py311; basedpyright pythonVersion 3.11; ci.yml python-version 3.11.
findings.recommendation: Move the pinned interpreter and CI default to 3.12 before 2026-10-31; keep the >=3.11 floor only if still wanted.

findings.title: basedpyright (strict) and semgrep never run in CI; both are local or advisory only
findings.evidence: grep for basedpyright/semgrep across all workflows returns nothing. basedpyright is a local language:system pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml:60-68); semgrep runs only via Qlty (.qlty/qlty.toml:96) mode=comment (advisory).
findings.recommendation: Add a blocking basedpyright strict job and a blocking semgrep job, or confirm the org python-ci.yml runs them.

findings.title: darglint abandoned: repo archived 2022-12-16, last release 2021-10-18 (55 months)
findings.evidence: uv.lock darglint 1.8.1 upload-time 2021-10-18T03:40:35Z; GitHub terrencepreilly/darglint archived 2022-12-16, read-only.
findings.recommendation: Drop darglint and fold docstring linting into ruff pydocstyle D rules; remove the [tool.darglint] config.

findings.title: Persistence layer writes terminal output; load_all prints via its own Console; library callers get stdout
findings.evidence: db.py:68 instantiates console = Console(); load_all prints at db.py:433,435,439,441,443. Two independent Console instances (db.py:68 and rendering.py:36). __init__.py advertises load_all for programmatic use.
findings.recommendation: Have load_all return per-step counts or take a callback and let cli.py render; at minimum route through rendering.console.

findings.title: detect-secrets absent from deps/venv; baseline enforced only via contributor pre-commit, no CI path
findings.evidence: uv run detect-secrets scan fails (not installed); detect-secrets is in no dependency group. It runs only via the pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml:64-70). No uv run path, no CI job.
findings.recommendation: Add detect-secrets to the dev dependency group and add a CI step that runs it against .secrets.baseline.

findings.title: Coverage threshold drift; .codecov.yml targets 80% but is orphaned (no Codecov upload)
findings.evidence: .codecov.yml:5,9 target 80% project and patch; pyproject.toml:115 fail_under=65 and ci.yml:39 coverage-threshold 65; grep codecov in workflows is empty (coverage flows to Qlty).
findings.recommendation: Delete .codecov.yml since Codecov is not in the pipeline, or wire it up and reconcile to a single number.

findings.title: Python 3.10 in compat matrix across 3 OS but forbidden by requires-python >=3.11
findings.evidence: python-compatibility.yml:41 matrix includes '3.10' across macOS/Windows/Linux; pyproject.toml:10 requires-python >=3.11,<4 and classifiers list only 3.11/3.12/3.13.
findings.recommendation: Drop 3.10 from the matrix, or lower requires-python to >=3.10 and add the classifier; pick one.

findings.title: Five published doc files absent from mkdocs nav; orphan pages, fatal under --strict
findings.evidence: mkdocs.yml:71-79 nav omits these tracked docs/ files; mkdocs builds them as unreachable pages and emits not-in-nav warnings (fatal under mkdocs build --strict).
findings.recommendation: Add legitimate reference docs to a nav section; move internal artifacts out of docs/ or add an mkdocs exclude.

findings.title: Internal process/retrospective files published in the user docs site
findings.evidence: All three sit under docs_dir and ship to the public Pages site. The retrospective (2026-04-25.md:169-175) lists unremediated defects; reusable-workflow-jobs.yaml is a CI registry.
findings.recommendation: Relocate these out of docs/ to a non-published path such as internal/ or .github/.

findings.title: README uv tool install gleif and PyPI badge assume a published package; repo is private, unpublished
findings.evidence: README.md:49 instructs uv tool install gleif; README.md:4 renders a pypi/pyversions badge. Repo is private (lessons-learned/2026-04-25.md:155), version 0.1.0, no PyPI release evidence.
findings.recommendation: Publish to PyPI, or remove the install block and PyPI badge until published, leaving the from-source path as primary.

findings.title: download.py 21% covered; download/extract path and zip-slip guard untested
findings.evidence: pytest coverage: download.py 79 stmts, 58 miss, 21%; missing 176-232 (download_dataset), 260-271 (_extract_zip incl. zip-slip guard), 303-315 (download_all). No download test file exists.
findings.recommendation: Mock the httpx AsyncClient and test fresh-vs-stale skip logic, the zip-slip guard, the no-CSV ValueError, and ZIP cleanup.

findings.title: CLI download/load/refresh and --isin branches have no tests
findings.evidence: cli.py 136 stmts, 42 miss, 69%; missing 89-96 (download), 105-136 (load), 146-155 (refresh), 210-212/223-225/259-260 (--isin). grep isin/download/load/refresh in tests returns nothing.
findings.recommendation: Add CliRunner tests for load against a fixture data dir, and for lei --isin / name --isin patching fetch_isins_batch; mock httpx for download/refresh.

findings.title: Scanner overlap with no authoritative-gate matrix: SAST x4, dep-scan x5, bandit x3
findings.evidence: SAST runs four ways (CodeQL, semgrep, bandit, radarlint qlty.toml:64-104), dependency scanning five ways (Trivy, OSV disabled, pip-audit, dependency-review, Renovate alerts), bandit in three places. Several Qlty plugins are mode=comment while the same checks block elsewhere.
findings.recommendation: Write a one-page authoritative-scanner matrix; drop bandit from one of its three homes; reassess radarlint/SonarQube rules on 2200 LOC.

findings.title: Transitive py 1.11.0 unmaintained (54 months), carries the accepted CVE
findings.evidence: uv.lock py 1.11.0 upload-time 2021-11-04 (PyPI: maintenance mode); pip-audit flags PYSEC-2022-42969 (ReDoS in py.path.svnwc, no fix); interrogate 1.7.0 still depends on py. CLI never touches the affected path.
findings.recommendation: Keep the documented ignore; revisit when interrogate drops py or when docstring tooling is consolidated.

findings.title: interrogate 1.7.0 stale (~26 months); sole reason py is in the tree
findings.evidence: uv.lock interrogate 1.7.0 upload-time 2024-04-07 (25.7 months as of 2026-05-29); 1.7.0 is the latest on PyPI. It is the only dependency that pulls in py.
findings.recommendation: Track upstream; if it stalls further, replace docstring-coverage gating with ruff D rules to drop both interrogate and py.

findings.title: httpx 0.28.1 latest release is 17.7 months old; nearing 18-month line (informational)
findings.evidence: uv.lock httpx 0.28.1 upload-time 2024-12-06 = 17.7 months as of 2026-05-29; 0.28.1 is still the current PyPI release and httpx is actively maintained.
findings.recommendation: No action; re-confirm maintenance status next audit cycle if no 0.29/1.0 ships.

findings.title: fail_under = 65 with stale raise-to-80 comment; oldest deferred note (2026-04-25)
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:115 fail_under = 65  # interim: raise to 80 once download.py and CLI command tests are added; introduced 2026-04-25, oldest unresolved deferred note. Current coverage 67.30%.
findings.recommendation: Close CQ-01 and CQ-02, then raise fail_under to 80 and delete the comment.

findings.title: rendering.py 62% covered; pure formatting branches untested
findings.evidence: rendering.py 126 stmts, 40 miss, 62%; missing 41-56 (collect_report_leis), 97-107 (render_exceptions_table), ISIN-column branches 162-164 and 192-194.
findings.recommendation: Unit-test the render helpers against constructed dataclasses using a Rich Console with record=True or captured stdout.

findings.title: RelatedEntity row-mapping comprehension duplicated four times
findings.evidence: grep -c 'direction="' = 4; the RelatedEntity list comprehension is repeated verbatim in get_children, get_siblings, and get_other_relationships, differing only in the direction literal.
findings.recommendation: Add a _rows_to_related(rows, direction) helper mirroring the existing _row_to_* helpers.

findings.title: ISIN-extraction comprehension duplicated between fetch_isins and fetch_isins_batch
findings.evidence: Identical comprehension [item['attributes']['isin'] for item in data if item.get('attributes', {}).get('isin')] at isin.py:61-65 and 92-96.
findings.recommendation: Extract a _extract_isins(response_json) -> list[str] helper used by both.

findings.title: get_status declares a precise tuple return but returns raw fetchall(); unchecked promise
findings.evidence: db.py:448-472 signature declares -> list[tuple[str, str, str, int]] but returns con.execute(...).fetchall() directly (466-472); duckdb fetchall is loosely typed, so basedpyright accepts it unchecked. cli.py:313 unpacks four columns positionally.
findings.recommendation: Narrow at the boundary with a row-mapping helper, or accept the loose typing once load_all/status tests (CQ-02) exist.

findings.title: 'ACTIVE' status literal hardcoded in six SQL bodies
findings.evidence: r.relationship_status = 'ACTIVE' inlined at queries.py:138,177,222,226,280,404,467; constants.py:153-160 already houses the analogous relationship-type literals.
findings.recommendation: Add ACTIVE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' to constants.py and reference it (string-build or bind as a parameter).

findings.title: ISIN endpoint URL defined in isin.py, not constants.py
findings.evidence: GLEIF_API_BASE = 'https://api.gleif.org/api/v1/lei-records' at isin.py:32; the golden-copy base URL and DATASET_URLS live in constants.py:21,50, whose docstring claims to own GLEIF endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Move GLEIF_API_BASE (and the named request timeout) into constants.py.

findings.title: Network magic numbers inline (timeout 600.0, chunk 65536, lei_length 20)
findings.evidence: timeout=600.0 (download.py:180), chunk_size=65536 (download.py:215), lei_length=20 local (cli.py:186); isin.py:33 names _REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 10.0, so the codebase is inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Name the download timeout and chunk size as module constants; promote LEI length to a shared constant.

findings.title: # noqa: PLC0415 on a function-local import despite the documented noqa ban; rule is inert and import is redundant (merges LEG-01)
findings.evidence: cli.py:105 carries # noqa: PLC0415 vs AGENTS.md:77 banning noqa. PLC0415 is a non-enabled Ruff preview rule (uv run ruff check --select PLC0415 passes; RUF100 flags it under narrow select). download is already imported at cli.py:41.
findings.recommendation: Hoist the import to module top and drop the noqa, or amend AGENTS.md to carve an explicit exception.

findings.title: RAD doc code example uses ? placeholders and a non-existent table_exists helper; contradicts actual $1 + catalog-exception style
findings.evidence: response-aware-development.md:37-48 uses conn.execute('... WHERE lei = ?', [lei]) and a table_exists guard; the codebase uses $1 named parameters everywhere and except duckdb.CatalogException (db.py:470). No table_exists helper exists.
findings.recommendation: Update the example to $1 and the catalog-exception pattern, or mark it as illustrative pseudocode.

findings.title: detect-secrets baseline generated_at predates later hook changes; regen due, unverifiable here
findings.evidence: .secrets.baseline generated_at 2026-04-27; all 9 entries are Hex High Entropy strings mapping to action rev SHA pins (false positives, correctly baselined). The file has changed since (renovate/trufflehog hooks added). Fresh scan blocked by SEC-02.
findings.recommendation: After SEC-02, regenerate and audit the baseline; confirm the 9 entries still map to SHA pins and none is orphaned.

findings.title: Build/scan jobs split between Python 3.11 and 3.12 with no stated reason
findings.evidence: sbom.yml:46, slsa-provenance.yml:61, docs.yml:56 build on 3.12; ci.yml:36, release.yml:27, security-analysis.yml:38, codeql.yml:34 use 3.11 (the declared floor and dev target).
findings.recommendation: Standardize build/scan jobs on 3.11, or add a one-line comment justifying 3.12 where used.

findings.title: darglint and interrogate pre-commit revs SHA-pinned without version comments, unlike every other hook
findings.evidence: .pre-commit-config.yaml:86 (darglint) and :94 (interrogate) are SHA-pinned with no # vX.Y.Z comment; every other hook carries one.
findings.recommendation: Add # vX.Y.Z comments matching the pinned SHAs for darglint and interrogate.

findings.title: Conventional-commit enforcement split (PR title vs local commit-msg); dependency-standards-validation job does no dependency check
findings.evidence: pr-validation.yml:35 enforces a Conventional Commits regex on the PR title; commitizen (.pre-commit-config.yaml:78-82) runs commit-msg locally only. The dependency-standards-validation job (pr-validation.yml:72) only re-reads title/body results and does no dependency check.
findings.recommendation: Confirm squash-merge uses the PR title, and rename dependency-standards-validation to reflect that it only gates title/body.

findings.title: Four empty .gitkeep dirs collide with same-named .md pages
findings.evidence: docs/development/ vs development.md, docs/getting-started/ vs getting-started.md; docs/reference/ is dead (nav uses cli-reference.md); docs/architecture/.gitkeep is redundant since the dir holds index.md and data-model.md.
findings.recommendation: Delete the four .gitkeep placeholder dirs.

findings.title: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] self-contradicts on SBOM format; still version 0.1.0; duplicate Changed sections
findings.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:18-22 changes the SBOM from SPDX to CycloneDX, but :26-27 still adds SPDX SBOM generation; two ### Changed subsections (lines 10 and 33); pyproject.toml:3 version still 0.1.0.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the SBOM entries to CycloneDX, merge the duplicate Changed sections, and cut a release or relabel the Unreleased content.

findings.title: No ADR directory for design decisions documented inline in architecture/index.md
findings.evidence: architecture/index.md:42-85 documents five decisions (DuckDB store, relationship direction, recursive-CTE cycle prevention, async download/sync load, frozen dataclasses) as prose; git ls-files finds no adr/ or decisions/ directory.
findings.recommendation: Add docs/adr/ with one short MADR ADR per decision and link from architecture/index.md.
